menuconfig DISK_DRIVERS
	bool "Disk Drivers"
	default y
	help
	  Enable disk drivers configuration

if DISK_DRIVERS

config DISK_DRIVER_RAM
	bool "RAM Disk"
	default y
	depends on DT_HAS_ZEPHYR_RAM_DISK_ENABLED
	help
	  RAM buffer used to emulate storage disk.
	  This option can be used to test the file
	  system.

module = DISK_DRIVER_RAM
module-str = ramdisk
source "subsys/logging/Kconfig.template.log_config"

config DISK_DRIVER_FLASH
	bool "Flash"
	default y
	depends on DT_HAS_ZEPHYR_FLASH_DISK_ENABLED
	select FLASH
	select FLASH_MAP
	help
	  Flash device is used for the file system.

if DISK_DRIVER_FLASH

module = DISK_DRIVER_FLASH
module-str = flashdisk
source "subsys/logging/Kconfig.template.log_config"

endif # DISK_DRIVER_FLASH

rsource "Kconfig.sdmmc"
rsource "Kconfig.mmc"
rsource "Kconfig.nvme"
rsource "Kconfig.loopback"

endif # DISK_DRIVERS
